simple: SentinelOne’s most complete package for large organizations: protects computers, servers, cloud workloads and accounts with one agent. AI right on the device blocks malware and ransomware and stops the attack on its own: ends the process, cuts the computer off from the network, restores encrypted files with one click (rollback). Protects servers, virtual machines, containers and Kubernetes (CWPP); controls the connection of USB drives and other devices and the host firewall; detects attacks on accounts in Active Directory and cloud directories (ITDR) and can disable a compromised account. The agentic AI SOC analyst triages alerts on its own; collects forensic data from devices for investigation (DFIR); agents build an inventory of all devices on the network and can isolate unknown ones (Network Discovery). SentinelOne experts hunt for threats (Managed Threat Hunting), help with deployment and train your team. Event history is kept for 90 days. 24/7 MDR costs extra.
classification: Forensic Data Collection is DFIR; Network Discovery (network inventory by agents) is not CAASM and stays in the text.
